Subject: Re: Discovery — hosting constraints (quick notes)

Laura / Marissa — thanks for the call this morning. Couple things we want captured as we prep internal security and procurement:

- Data residency: all PHI must remain in us-west-2 (AWS GovCloud not required, standard us-west-2 acceptable)
- Network: no outgoing internet from inference hosts; egress must be via customer-managed NAT/gateway
- Air-gap requirement: not fully air-gapped, but traffic must traverse a transit VPC with strict ACLs
- Audit/logs: need 90 days of request-level audit logs exposed to our SIEM (Splunk)

Can you confirm Redwood can deliver per-token logs (anonymized keys ok) and operate behind customer NAT? Also if you can share a network diagram we can use in procurement.

Thanks,
Arjun
Security & Compliance Lead
StellaHealth
